currentCard.prompt: Какое вещество обычно составляет около половины массы тела взрослого человека?

answers.note: Железо входит в гемоглобин; атомы железа в нём связывают кислород.
В мозге и почках вода составляет около 80–85% массы этих органов.
Соли кальция образуют минеральные кристаллы костной ткани, придающие ей твёрдость.
Коллагеновые волокна образуют белковую основу матрикса кости и придают костям гибкость.

currentCard.explanation: Вода обычно составляет 50–60% массы тела взрослого человека; в пожилом возрасте доля может снижаться примерно до 45%. Вода служит средой для химических реакций организма.

source.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: Body Fluids and Fluid Compartments

literal.prompt: Какое вещество обычно составляет около половины массы тела взрослого человека?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 26.1 L36 directly states water50–60% adult body mass, with development/old-age variation. «Обычно», «около половины», «взрослого» coherently express this approximate typical adult range; not an exact universal50%. The same passage gives water as the predominant component.18.3 L61–62 identifies iron as trace;6.3 L89–90 and4.3 L138 identify calcium salts/collagen as mineral/protein skeletal components, not an alternative half-body water fraction. All labels are real body constituents, allowing confusion about blood/mineral/structural-protein prominence rather than invented entities. Exactly key1 independently supported.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Вода обычно составляет 50–60% массы тела взрослого человека; в пожилом возрасте доля может снижаться примерно до 45%. Вода служит средой для химических реакций организма.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 26.1 L36 explicitly supports adults50–60% and old-age decline as low45%, preserving «обычно»/«может»/«примерно» rather than fixed every-adult proportions. L31 says life reactions occur in aqueous solutions, directly supporting water as reaction medium. Two sentences name water and explain its predominance/use, under70 words. No intake amount, beverage advice or CDC proposition is implied.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Железо входит в гемоглобин; атомы железа в нём связывают кислород.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 18.3 L44–47 explicitly places iron in heme within hemoglobin and binds oxygen at iron centres (Fe2+ in the primary text). The ordinary wording «атомы железа в нём» names those bound iron centres, not neutral free metal or iron as an independent blood cell. This is a concrete own-iron fact, separately useful from the body-mass question.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: В мозге и почках вода составляет около 80–85% массы этих органов.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 26.1 L36 and figure-textL39 explicitly give brain/kidneys80–85% of THEIR mass as water. The note keeps the organ-mass denominator and «около», not80–85% of all water/body mass. Named organ-specific proportions add a concrete own-water fact beyond the prompt/key adult whole-body approximate-half fraction.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Соли кальция образуют минеральные кристаллы костной ткани, придающие ей твёрдость.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 6.3 L89–90 directly describes calcium-salt/hydroxyapatite mineral crystals giving bone hardness/strength;4.3 L138 confirms mineralized calcium-phosphate matrix. The note assigns hardness to salts, not metallic elemental calcium, and teaches a meaningful own-calcium role without saying bone mineral forms half of body mass.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Коллагеновые волокна образуют белковую основу матрикса кости и придают костям гибкость.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 4.3 L83 explicitly identifies collagen fibers as fibrous protein;6.3 L89–90 assigns them matrix scaffold/flexibility, and4.3 L138 says bone matrix mostly contains collagen fibers with mineral and would be brittle without collagen. The note correctly distinguishes protein scaffold/flexibility from calcium-mineral hardness, a useful own-collagen fact.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какое вещество обычно составляет около половины массы тела взрослого человека?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Железо входит в гемоглобин; атомы железа в нём связывают кислород.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: Standalone nominative «Железо» naturally names a substance in response to «Какое вещество ...?»; same independent label construction as all options.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: A real body constituent associated with blood/hemoglobin, plausibly selected by someone confusing physiological importance with mass predominance; not a fictional chemical.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: 26.1 L36 explicitly supplies water at50–60%;18.3 L61–62 calls iron a trace mineral. Iron is not an additional half-body key.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: 18.3 L44–47 directly supports iron within hemoglobin heme and binding oxygen at those iron centres. Wording does not assert neutral metallic iron in blood; meaningful own-option teaching.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какое вещество обычно составляет около половины массы тела взрослого человека?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: В мозге и почках вода составляет около 80–85% массы этих органов.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Вода» is a grammatical nominative substance name; feminine lexical gender does not conflict with generic «вещество» in independent naming.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Real familiar body constituent among blood/mineral/protein components. No key-only length or punctuation clue; adult EASY knowledge gives the mass comparison.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: 26.1 L36 independently states typical adult50–60% body mass as water; age variation is explicitly qualified in prompt/explanation. Exactly key1.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: Brain/kidney80–85% EACH organ mass atL36/L39 is an additional own-water fact beyond whole-body approximate-half fraction; denominator/qualification preserved.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какое вещество обычно составляет около половины массы тела взрослого человека?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Соли кальция образуют минеральные кристаллы костной ткани, придающие ей твёрдость.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Кальций» is a nominative substance-name label, grammatically consistent with other labels.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: A genuine prominent skeletal mineral element, plausible confusion about hard tissue/overall body composition for a nonexpert.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: 6.3 L89–90/4.3 L138 describe calcium-salt bone mineral, while26.1 L36 gives water as50–60% whole body. Calcium is not another usual half-mass component.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: Calcium salts form mineral crystals and supply bone hardness, directly supported; note specifically says salts rather than attributing bone to lumps of metallic calcium.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какое вещество обычно составляет около половины массы тела взрослого человека?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Коллагеновые волокна образуют белковую основу матрикса кости и придают костям гибкость.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Белок коллаген» is a coherent nominative protein-name label; qualifier identifies the material, not a grammatical key hint.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Real abundant connective-tissue structural protein, plausibly confused with the chief mass component by someone thinking of flesh/bones; same broad substance category.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: 4.3 L83/L138 and6.3 L89–90 identify fibrous protein scaffold;26.1 L36 explicitly assigns the typical half-mass fraction to water, so collagen is not a second key.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: Protein matrix scaffold and flexibility are directly supported; note teaches collagen’s own role and correctly distinguishes it from calcium-mineral hardness.

absoluteLevel.assessment: Water as a large, roughly half-or-more fraction of an adult body is broad adult school/general knowledge. No exact brain percentage, ionic chemistry or tissue histology is needed to solve. All choices are genuine body constituents; mineral/blood/protein roles provide thematic plausible confusion, and someone knowing scale can exclude them. The precise adult50–60%/older45% qualifications are supported rather than demanding specialist population calculations.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: Water is about80–85% of brain and kidney mass.
correctNoteExtraFact.ground: Prompt/key concerns whole adult body around half; organ-specific higher proportions for named brain/kidneys are additional own-water facts.26.1 L36/L39 directly supplies numbers/denominators.
